resources.string: A private, offline gradebook a teacher owns outright: create, edit and delete every class, student, category, assignment, mark, attendance record, participation note, parent contact and seating position without an account or a server. See an explainable running average that names the rounding rule, the missing-work rule and every category it excluded, export CSV and PDF, and keep a restorable backup file. Free for one class up to 20 students; unlocked once, not rented.
